The assembly kernels this repository's Rust crate builds (`build.rs`).
Every exported symbol is `blake3_servil_*`, so a binary that links this
crate and official BLAKE3 keeps each one's kernels apart.

- AArch64: the integer + NEON kernels (`blake3_neon_hybrid_aarch64.S`,
  generated by `tools/gen_neon_hybrid.py`), and the SME2 kernels
  (`blake3_sme2_aarch64.S`; `blake3_sme2_hybrid_aarch64.S`, generated by
  `tools/gen_sme2_hybrid.py`).
- x86-64: official BLAKE3's SSE4.1, AVX2 and AVX-512 kernels, renamed,
  with the AVX2 and AVX-512 batch kernels' loads kept within each input
  (`blake3_{sse41,avx2,avx512}_x86-64_unix.S`); the
  fork's pass of whole chunks with a partial one
  (`blake3_partial_x86-64_unix.S`, generated by `tools/gen_x86.py`); and the
  chunk root in one call (`blake3_chunk_root_x86-64_unix.S`, generated
  by `tools/gen_x86_chunk_root.py`).

`tools/check-builds.sh` fails when a generated file and its generator
differ. The proofs of every kernel are in `tools/verify/` (its README);
the fork's C API is `capi/b3.h`.
